MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of syllables has the same initial and final but a different meaning because of the tone? (1 mark)
   A. dà (big) and xiǎo (small)
   B. bā (eight) and mā (mother)
   C. nǐ (you) and hǎo (good)
   D. mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)

2. What is the neutral tone? (1 mark)
   A. A tone that falls sharply
   B. A light, short tone written without a mark
   C. A very loud tone
   D. A tone that rises high

3. What does 那是我哥哥 nà shì wǒ gēge mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my sister
   B. This is my younger brother
   C. That is my mother
   D. That is my older brother

4. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室在床。
   B. 在床卧室。
   C. 床卧室在。
   D. 床在卧室。

5. Which word means "under" in 椅子在桌子下? (1 mark)
   A. 桌
   B. 在
   C. 下
   D. 上

6. In the Swahili week, which day is counted as day 1? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Monday
   C. Sunday
   D. Saturday

7. What does 祝 (zhù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knife
   B. They
   C. Cup
   D. To wish

8. What does 他们 (tāmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cup
   B. To wish
   C. They
   D. We

9. What does 我喜欢吃香蕉 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a banana tree
   B. I do not like bananas
   C. I am eating tea
   D. I like to eat bananas

10. Which Chinese word means "tea"? (1 mark)
   A. 茶 chá
   B. 葡萄 pútao
   C. 午饭 wǔfàn
   D. 喝 hē

11. Which Chinese word means "what"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 肉 ròu
   C. 什么 shénme
   D. 葡萄 pútao

12. Which sentence do we use to name a weather picture? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳在哪儿?
   B. 我叫太阳。
   C. 你好太阳。
   D. 这是太阳。

13. Which Chinese word means "drought"? (1 mark)
   A. 干旱 gānhàn
   B. 小 xiǎo
   C. 刮风 guā fēng
   D. 天 tiān

14. Which sentence describes the position of the window above the sofa? (1 mark)
   A. 浴室在花园旁边。
   B. 窗户在沙发上面。
   C. 沙发在窗户上面。
   D. 沙发在门旁边。

15. What does 你好 (nǐ hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. To be called
   C. Hello
   D. Classmates

16. Which sentence means "Hello, teacher!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 老师好!
   C. 再见!
   D. 你呢?

17. What does 哪儿 (nǎr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Where
   C. House
   D. Toilet

18. What does 星期六 (xīngqīliù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Church
   B. Eight
   C. Saturday
   D. Three

19. Which sentence means "On Sunday, go to church."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期六在家休息。
   B. 星期天,去教堂。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 今天星期三。

20. What does 星期五,去清真寺 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, go to church
   B. On Friday, rest at home
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque
   D. On Monday, go to school

21. Which word is pronounced shénme? (1 mark)
   A. 零食
   B. 蔬菜
   C. 牛奶
   D. 什么

22. What does 笑 (xiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nose
   B. To brush teeth
   C. To laugh, to smile
   D. To look, to see

23. On which vowel does the tone mark go in nǐ? (1 mark)
   A. i
   B. n
   C. u
   D. No vowel

24. What does 家 (jiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daughter
   B. Son
   C. Home, family
   D. Older sister

25. Which Chinese word means "ten"? (1 mark)
   A. 十 shí
   B. 五 wǔ
   C. 九 jiǔ
   D. 三 sān

26. Which Chinese word means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 周 zhōu
   B. 四 sì
   C. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   D. 星期三 xīngqīsān

27. What does 五 (wǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Nine
   C. Five
   D. Four

28. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn xiǎo. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is very big.
   B. Today there are clouds.
   C. The wind is very light.
   D. The rain is heavy.

29. Which word is pronounced shàngmiàn? (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱
   B. 放
   C. 沙发
   D. 上面

30. Which stroke is written first in 右? (1 mark)
   A. 横 héng
   B. 竖 shù
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 点 diǎn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌. (3 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵. (2 marks)

33. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!" (2 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜. (2 marks)

35. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日. (3 marks)

36. Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin. (3 marks)

37. Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡. (3 marks)

38. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床. (2 marks)

39. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?" (3 marks)

40. Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps. (4 marks)

41. Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有. (5 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school." (3 marks)

43. Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence. (3 marks)

44. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀. (3 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们. (3 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My name is Xiaoming." (2 marks)

47. Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why. (2 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   Only the tone separates mā and mǎ.

2. B — A light, short tone written without a mark
   The neutral tone is light and short, as in the second syllable of māma.

3. D — That is my older brother
   那 is that and 哥哥 is older brother.

4. D — 床在卧室。
   The pattern is thing + 在 + place.

5. C — 下
   下 xià means under or below.

6. D — Saturday
   Jumamosi, Saturday, is day one, so Monday is day three (Jumatatu).

7. D — To wish
   祝 (zhù) means to wish.

8. C — They
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

9. D — I like to eat bananas
   喜欢 is like, 吃 is eat and 香蕉 is banana.

10. A — 茶 chá
   茶 (chá) means tea.

11. C — 什么 shénme
   什么 (shénme) means what.

12. D — 这是太阳。
   这是 + word names what we see.

13. A — 干旱 gānhàn
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

14. B — 窗户在沙发上面。
   上面 means above.

15. C — Hello
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

16. B — 老师好!
   老师好! (lǎoshī hǎo!) means "Hello, teacher!".

17. B — Where
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

18. C — Saturday
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

19. B — 星期天,去教堂。
   星期天,去教堂。 (xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.) means "On Sunday, go to church.".

20. C — On Friday, go to the mosque
   清真寺 is a mosque.

21. D — 什么
   什么 is pronounced shénme and means what.

22. C — To laugh, to smile
   笑 (xiào) means to laugh, to smile.

23. A — i
   The only vowel is i, and the mark replaces its dot.

24. C — Home, family
   家 (jiā) means home, family.

25. A — 十 shí
   十 (shí) means ten.

26. D — 星期三 xīngqīsān
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

27. C — Five
   五 (wǔ) means five.

28. C — The wind is very light.
   fēng hěn xiǎo. is 风很小。, which means "The wind is very light.".

29. D — 上面
   上面 is pronounced shàngmiàn and means above.

30. C — 撇 piě
   右 begins with the falling stroke.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 上面: shàngmiàn, above. 周: zhōu, week (short form). 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
